corrections.where: Natural_Exploring.md, bullet beginning '- Caribbean spiny lobsters', further-test sentence
corrections.finding: Misstates the source and is unclear: the lobsters were in a Faraday cage (a shield) with fields replicating a site about 400 km north or south; 'a cage of coils making an instrument's reading' makes the cage the coils and has coils making a reading rather than a person's coils matching an instrument's reading of a place.
corrections.fixed_text: - Caribbean spiny lobsters, a person taking them away from where they live along a winding route with no useful chemical, visual or magnetic cue on the way, some boxes with swinging magnets, orient toward home on a tether in an arena, their eyes under a cover. In a further test, in a Faraday cage with a person's coils matching an instrument's reading of the magnetic field of a place some 400 km north of home, they walk south-southwest, and with coils matching an instrument's reading of a place 400 km south, they walk about north. Biology names it true navigation with a magnetic map, the first in an invertebrate, the map's form still-possibling. What a self observes is a lobster's heading changing as a person's coils change something at its surface, a change physics' instruments read as a magnetic field; a lobster is-not observing magnetism, magnetism being physics' accounting from outside a lobster's surface. A lobster finds where it is is-not home and aims from that is-not to home, with no cue of its route. *(possible exploring)*

corrections.where: Natural_Exploring.md, bullet beginning '- Fishery catches over 56 years', clause 'imprinting and long-term memory a store story over it'
corrections.finding: Dissolved word: 'memory' used as the set's own word (and 'store story' is unclear wording); the source only has the authors calling it magnetic imprinting.
corrections.fixed_text: - Fishery catches over 56 years give each year's share of sockeye salmon coming home to the Fraser River north or south of Vancouver Island, and that share goes with a physics model's reading of Earth's magnetic field, how near its reading at points along each way comes to its reading at the Fraser's mouth in the year of those salmon going out to sea as young fish; magnetic imprinting is its authors' explaining of that going-with, and no observing there is a salmon observing magnetism. Near its river a salmon likely finds its own stream by smell, and a 1953 test finds all but 8 of 73 salmon with their noses open coming back up the branch of their first capture, and 28 of 70 with a plug in their noses going up the other branch. A salmon's going home is its own parities with its surface, from its own side, its home its own prior same-existing now-existing in it; magnetism is an instrument's record from outside a salmon's surface, imprinting a story over it, and what a salmon's surface is from its own side across an ocean is still-possibling. Along a river a salmon goes from each is-not, not that water, to is. *(possible exploring)*
